title: Friday Night Magic 2006: card flavor text

entities.name: Ailheen
entities.description: Speaker of the Council who calls for casting out elves of Deep Shadow.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Dragon who gave his life defending Dominaria, as his mother had.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: Mountains from which goblins poured like lava.

events.summary: Ailheen calls for the aberrant elves to be cast out.
Darigaaz gives his life defending Dominaria from self-styled gods.
events.quote: Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

events.summary: Goblins pour from Skirk Ridge devouring all in their path.
events.quote: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.
